extraction_notes: Characterization tables/figures (for example SI Tables S1, S5, S6, S8, S9 except composition information used in components) and thermodynamic-equilibrium/DFT content were not extracted as performance records. SI Table S4 literature rows from other papers were excluded; only rows marked This work were used, and duplicate conditions were merged where possible.
